ios.desc:
Poop Map is the social poop tracker. Drop a pin every time nature calls, rate the throne and watch your map fill up: at home, at work and everywhere you travel.

PIN EVERY POOP
• One tap drops a pin where you are
• Give it stars, pick a mood, add a note or a selfie
• Bristol stool type and color, if you're curious
• Your usual places fill themselves in

SEE WHERE YOUR FRIENDS GO
• Follow friends and see their drops in your feed
• Like, comment and react
• You choose who sees your drops: everyone, followers or only you

SETTLE WHO POOPS THE MOST
• Start a private league with friends, family or coworkers
• Monthly standings, league chat and ridiculous bragging rights
• Global rankings: all time for everyone, the last 30 days and the year with Pro

UNLOCK BADGES AROUND THE WORLD
• Mile High Club, Passport Control and many more
• Collect countries, keep your streak alive and beat your records

DECORATE YOUR THRONE ROOM
• Make it yours, from the floor to the sink
• Friends visit, flush and leave little gifts

YOUR DOG'S BUSINESS COUNTS TOO
• Log walks, pet poops and pees
• Share your pet with the whole family

YOUR YEAR, DROP BY DROP
• A Poop Calendar with every drop of the year
• Streaks, stats, likes and every country you've pooped in
• Siri, Home Screen widgets and an Apple Watch app for quick drops

POOP MAP PRO
• Free to use, with an optional Pro subscription
• Pro adds every sticker and pin color, app icons, 30-day and 1-year rankings, translated comments and bios, and shows who flushed your toilet

Poop Map works on iPhone, iPad and iPhone Duo, in 10 languages.
